records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

records.subject: Welcome aboard, River Group
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *River Group* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no project, no invite, no tickets, and zero replies to either outreach email ([email:62ef0b9a], [email:bb64a74d]). No signal of engagement at all; stall_reasons cover all three milestones. Starter plan, single admin. Unaided activation in the remaining 8 days looks unlikely though not impossible.

draft.subject: Getting your first project set up in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

I know a new tool is easy to put off in a busy week, so I wanted to check in directly.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating the first one is usually the quickest way to see whether it fits how River Group works. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
